scientific_integrity: The matrix-inverse identity, integrals, boundary cases and optimization are established analytically. Exact-rational finite calculations corroborate but do not replace the universal proof. No external independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Proved for complete bipartite metric graphs with both vertex sides of size at least two, rank-one strictly positive edge lengths, standard arclength measure, and no interior finite-element nodes. No conclusion for general positive length matrices; independent bibliographic priority review outstanding.
title: Sharp nodal spline projection norms on rank-one bipartite metric graphs
